title: CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md with @ instead of a plain link
counterExample: Routes get shorter, but Cheap and the score go down: AGENTS.md is now in the start load, so its recorded read counts as a re-read. Not part of better.
reason: A plain Markdown link does not load AGENTS.md at start. The agent must spend one read on it in every session. With @AGENTS.md it is in the start load.

edits.find: Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) first. It names the files to read for each task.
edits.replace:
@AGENTS.md

AGENTS.md (loaded above) names the files to read for each task.
